predictions.statement: A complex contour representation combined with full Jacobi reflection admits an explicit exponentially decaying Fourier tail bound; no zeros or RH are used.
The reflected finite contour head has H_N(0+iT)=0 exactly, permitting an error proportional to sigma.
The estimate alone does not supply nonnegativity of the finite coupled head uniformly in sigma,T; this must be demonstrated, not assumed.

numerical_test_plan.reference: xi via independent zeta/gamma only as diagnostic, not sign input
numerical_test_plan.gate: analytic proof of bounds; interval finite-point checks do not certify a continuum

additional_pretest_controls.test: At N=1, theta=1/4, p=1/4+10i: real-axis head minus paired-ray head equals the integral of the finite modular defect on [0,i theta].
additional_pretest_controls.expected: agreement; omitting the defect produces a nonzero mismatch

additional_pretest_controls.test: At sigma=1/4,T=20 with registered cutoff, replace reflected -theta by +theta in the second ray.
additional_pretest_controls.expected: independent xi reference and the paid error envelope reject the wrong formula
